verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator's own multi-item operations are limited to migration. A user can transfer codes from an old device by creating and scanning a QR code, and community users describe exporting all saved codes into one QR code. Synced codes also arrive on a new device together. Everyday management (edit, delete, reorder) is documented only per code, and there is no scripting, API or AI-driven batch interface. missing for 10: bulk select/edit/delete, programmatic or automated bulk operations, first-party docs explicitly describing multi-account export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Google Authenticator has a feature to allow export of all saved codes into one QR code for re-import into Google Authenticator running on another device.
Google Authenticator's export QR code bundles multiple accounts.
When you sign in to your Google Account within Google Authenticator on a new device, your codes are automatically synced to this device.
